headline: The marker colours open on hover now, and removing markers says what actually happened.
notes: Hover the marker flag and the colour bar opens, the same way the clip colour list does
The bar carries the colours, Default, and Remove Trace+ markers, so every gesture is something you can point at
Fixed: marker colours and marker removal read the sequence a second way when the first read comes back empty. Both of them read the list back, and only they were failing
Removing markers now says which wall it hit: nothing on screen, no markers of ours, Premiere would not give up the names, or Premiere accepted the request and left them there
The scan report has a markers section showing exactly what the last press did, sequence by sequence
